source_documents.title: Role of Conical Intersections on the Efficiency of Fluorescent Organic Molecular Crystals

reference_evidence_units.quote: α-DCS is a DSB derivative displaying an impressive rise of QEF from 0.002 to 0.90 from the solution to single crystal.
reference_evidence_units.subject: alpha-DCS
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Chloroform solution versus single crystal; source calculations use TD-omegaB97X-D/6-31G(d), PCM solution and OEEC crystal embedding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The paper reports solution QEF 0.002 and single-crystal QEF 0.90 for alpha-DCS.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Experimental values are reproduced from reference 5, not new measurements in this computational paper.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Here, the FC geometry had a tilt of 62.9° but the planarization of S1 was signiﬁcantly hindered, only reaching 47.1°.
reference_evidence_units.subject: alpha-DCS
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Chloroform solution versus single crystal; source calculations use TD-omegaB97X-D/6-31G(d), PCM solution and OEEC crystal embedding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Crystal embedding limits excited-state planarization: central-ring tilt changes from 62.9 to 47.1 degrees, versus 67.2 to 21.3 degrees in solution.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Optimized static geometries, not measured angular dynamics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The sheet-like packing in the α-DCS crystal energetically encourages excited molecules to remain in their packing geometry
reference_evidence_units.subject: alpha-DCS
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Chloroform solution versus single crystal; source calculations use TD-omegaB97X-D/6-31G(d), PCM solution and OEEC crystal embedding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Neighboring face-to-face units sterically hinder departure from the crystal geometry.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This environmental restriction is the enabling condition for the CI-access explanation, not a separate demonstrated harmonic RIM cause.

reference_evidence_units.quote: We located a similar conical intersection for α-DCS, where the rotation was of 88.8° about the same vinylene bond
reference_evidence_units.subject: alpha-DCS
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Chloroform solution versus single crystal; source calculations use TD-omegaB97X-D/6-31G(d), PCM solution and OEEC crystal embedding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: A solution CI is reached by nearly perpendicular vinylene rotation; the reported structure has no pyramidalization.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The quotation is a partial sentence; the no-pyramidalization finding appears immediately afterward on the same page.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the crystal packing is too dense to allow for the backbone to draw an arc of nearly a right angle
reference_evidence_units.subject: alpha-DCS
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Chloroform solution versus single crystal; source calculations use TD-omegaB97X-D/6-31G(d), PCM solution and OEEC crystal embedding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Crystal packing is argued to block the solution-like CI distortion.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The crystal penalty-function search instead yields an extremely distorted stretching geometry, too distorted for multireference evaluation; a reliable crystal CI energy was not obtained.

reference_evidence_units.subject: alpha-DCS
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Chloroform solution versus single crystal; source calculations use TD-omegaB97X-D/6-31G(d), PCM solution and OEEC crystal embedding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Table 3 gives solution/crystal kr 0.35/0.43 and knr 175/0.05 ns^-1; low-frequency reorganization energy is calculated as 95/46 meV for vacuum/crystal.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Table visually inspected. Rates are imported experimental values (reference 5); the nearby prose says nonradiative rates 'increase' for alpha-DCS, inconsistent with this row. Do not repeat that prose as a quantitative fact.

reference_evidence_units.quote: no clear trends emerge linking the quenching of vibrational modes upon crystallization to the change in QEF of the systems
reference_evidence_units.subject: alpha-DCS
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Chloroform solution versus single crystal; source calculations use TD-omegaB97X-D/6-31G(d), PCM solution and OEEC crystal embedding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The series analysis does not correlate harmonic vibrational suppression with QEF, while allowing a possible contribution.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Series-level qualification, not proof that all internal motions are irrelevant.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Vibrational decay was found not to be a strong nonradiative decay channel in either molecules, making them ill-suited to the RIM model.
reference_evidence_units.subject: alpha-DCS
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Chloroform solution versus single crystal; source calculations use TD-omegaB97X-D/6-31G(d), PCM solution and OEEC crystal embedding.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The concluding interpretation favors RACI for HBT and alpha-DCS over the specific harmonic-vibrational RIM model.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This narrows RIM rather than disproving all steric motion restriction; the broad benchmark families overlap.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Sheet-like face-to-face neighbors provide the steric restriction enabling RACI.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source tabulates a large fall in knr with only modest kr change. This is a kinetic description of the CI interpretation, not an independent cause.

reference_mechanisms.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source centrally attributes the solution-to-crystal enhancement to blocking CI-reaching vinylene rotation; the inaccessible crystal MECI remains computationally unresolved.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The source explicitly finds the harmonic RIM account inadequate, though low-frequency modes decrease and a contribution cannot be excluded. Broad steric rotational blocking is represented by packing and RACI rather than added as an unqualified RIM label.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Sheet-like face-to-face neighbors provide the steric restriction enabling RACI.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest binding, pore uptake or host inclusion mechanism is established; a solvent or self-assembly is not automatically host-guest chemistry.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific CT or TICT mechanism is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific excited-state proton-transfer pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on is established; energy transfer and CT character are not by themselves PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Exciton coupling is computed in the paper but efficient excitonic dissipation is rejected for this series; no exciton mechanism is needed to explain alpha-DCS enhancement.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The source tabulates a large fall in knr with only modest kr change. This is a kinetic description of the CI interpretation, not an independent cause.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No operative target-specific triplet or metal-mediated pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The source centrally attributes the solution-to-crystal enhancement to blocking CI-reaching vinylene rotation; the inaccessible crystal MECI remains computationally unresolved.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-singlet-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established; higher-state absorption alone is insufficient.
